item_name: Rothco G.I. Type Web Belt Buckle And Tip Pack
item_short_desc: Upgrade or replace your web belt accessories with Rothco's Web Belt Buckle and Tip Pack. Designed to fit 1.25 inch wide web belts, this durable iron buckle and tip offer long-lasting functionality and style. The set is perfect for creating a custom look or restoring worn-out belts, ensuring your belt remains secure and reliable. Available in multiple color options, the buckle and tip complement a wide range of outfits and belt designs.
